title: Maximum Score of a Split
summary: Given an integer array nums, find the maximum score by selecting a split index i where the score is calculated as the difference between the prefix sum up to i and the minimum value in the suffix starting from i+1.
statement: Given an integer array nums, find the maximum score by selecting a split index i where the score is calculated as the difference between the prefix sum up to i and the minimum value in the suffix starting from i+1.
constraints: nums contains at least two and up to 100,000 signed integers.
Score equals the prefix sum through i minus the minimum value strictly to its right.
hints: Each split needs a left prefix sum and the minimum strictly to its right.
Precompute suffix minima, then scan split points while accumulating the prefix.
Evaluate prefix-suffixMin[i+1] at every legal split and keep the maximum.
The two precomputed quantities exactly match the score definition for each split, so examining all splits finds the optimum.
editorial: The two precomputed quantities exactly match the score definition for each split, so examining all splits finds the optimum.

tests.explanation: Splitting after 3 gives prefix twelve minus suffix minimum -5, producing the maximum score seventeen.
The only split scores one minus two, or -1.
